posts.headline: One Nut Barner has now gone twenty-eight straight editions without a single word, and Put it in Ra's absurd 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and ZERO rings is officially the most disrespected résumé this league has ever produced.
posts.detail: Two seasons, a .714 win pct, and still no hardware — the silence is starting to sound like guilt.

posts.headline: Draft night has arrived and Big Head STILL hasn't explained how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: A 5.5 average finish and a fluke ring don't mix — the fluke jury is picking tonight.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafts tonight still owning the single worst résumé in the entire league, and nothing suggests the untalented tenth suddenly found a war room.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish is the bar, and it's a low one to clear.

posts.headline: Thicks and the #FreeMaxx Champions build their title defense tonight, and a 14-14 career record with a 5.5 average finish says the ring has carried the résumé for two straight seasons.
posts.detail: One ring, two mediocre finishes — tonight's draft either proves it wasn't a fluke or buries the crown for good.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way walks into the draft room off a 10th-place, 6-8 rookie disaster, and Auntie Thomas needs a real roster, not just a Southern-auntie voice, to climb out of the basement.
posts.detail: A 0.429 winPct and a 10th-place average finish is the entire body of work — tonight's picks are the only sermon that matters.
